description:
*🙏 Lord Ranchhoddas Darshan Yoga 🙏*
*Rotary Club of Skycity Borivli - Spiritual Bonding Tour*

Today, *30th October, 2026*, our Rotary family was blessed with divine Darshan Yoga of *Lord Ranchhoddas at Dakor, Gujarat - 6 PM to 8 PM.*

Members of Rotary Club of Skycity Borivli, along with family, took blessings of Lord Ranchhoddas and prayed for the well-being, peace and prosperity of all.

Led by President *Rtn. Rajesh Sahu* and Team, we prayed together in harmony and sought divine blessings for our club and society.

It was indeed a moment of great *spiritual bonding and togetherness*, reminding us of the meaningful purpose of life - _Service Above Self with Faith._

Heartfelt gratitude to *Rtn. Praful Jobanputra* for his dedicated efforts and planning to make this divine darshan successful.

*Date: 30th October, 2026 | Time: 6 PM to 8 PM*
*Venue: Dakor, Gujarat*

*Faith Unites. Service Binds. Fellowship Strengthens.*

President Rtn Rajesh Sahu and Team.
*Rotary Club of Skycity Borivli*
